```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(BayesFactor)
library(knitr)
```

In the following, we present exploratory analyses of pull scores. We did not specify how we would analyze pull scores in the Stage 1 report, so, here, we present descriptive statistics and predict pull scores from ideology.

There are six different pull scores:

- FAV on MJP
- MJP on FAV
- MD on Profit
- Profit on MD
- FAV on P
- P on FAV

## Read in data

```{r}
nhb1a <- read.csv('../../data/nhb1a_processed.csv')
nhb1b <- read.csv('../../data/nhb1b_processed.csv')
nhb2 <- read.csv('../../data/nhb2_processed.csv')
nhb3 <- read.csv('../../data/nhb3_processed.csv')
```

## Write functions 

```{r}
plot_pullscores <- function(data, title){
  pull_scores <- c("Pull_FAVonMJP", "Pull_MJPonFAV", "Pull_MDonProfit", 
                   "Pull_ProfitonMD", "Pull_FAVonP", "Pull_PonFAV")
  datLong <- melt(data, 
              id.vars = "X", 
              measure.vars = pull_scores,
              variable.name = "Factor", value.name = "Pull")
  ggplot(datLong, mapping = aes(x = Pull)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "count") +
    facet_wrap(vars(Factor)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title)
}

analyze_pullscores1 <- function(data){
  pull_scores <- c("Pull_FAVonMJP", "Pull_MJPonFAV", "Pull_MDonProfit", 
                   "Pull_ProfitonMD", "Pull_FAVonP", "Pull_PonFAV")
  datLong <- melt(data, 
                  id.vars = "X", 
                  measure.vars = pull_scores,
                  variable.name = "Factor", value.name = "Pull")
  
  MEANS <- tapply(datLong$Pull, datLong$Factor, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
  SDS <- tapply(datLong$Pull, datLong$Factor, sd, na.rm=TRUE)
  
  freqres <- matrix(NA, nrow=6, ncol=4)
  bfs <- rep(NA, 6)
  
  for(i in 1:6){
    formula <- as.formula(paste(pull_scores[i], "~ composite_political_orientation_z"))
    freqres[i,] <- summary(
      lm(formula, data))$coefficients["composite_political_orientation_z",]
    bfs[i] <- extractBF(lmBF(formula, data = data))$bf
  }
  
  res <- data.frame(Mean_Score = MEANS,
                    SD_Score = SDS,
                    beta = freqres[,1],
                    p_value = freqres[,4],
                    bf = bfs)
  res
}

analyze_pullscores2 <- function(data){
  pull_scores <- c("Pull_FAVonMJP", "Pull_MJPonFAV", "Pull_MDonProfit", 
                   "Pull_ProfitonMD", "Pull_FAVonP", "Pull_PonFAV")
  conditions <- unique(data$condition)
  datLong <- melt(data, 
                  id.vars = c("X", "condition"), 
                  measure.vars = pull_scores,
                  variable.name = "Factor", value.name = "Pull")
  
  MEANS <- matrix(NA, ncol=length(conditions), nrow=6)
  SDS <- matrix(NA, ncol=length(conditions), nrow=6)
  
  for(i in seq_along(conditions)){
    datLongCondition <- datLong[datLong$condition== conditions[i], ]
    MEANS[,i] <- tapply(datLongCondition$Pull, datLongCondition$Factor, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
    SDS[,i] <- tapply(datLongCondition$Pull, datLongCondition$Factor, sd, na.rm=TRUE)
  }
  
  freqres <- array(NA, dim=c(length(conditions), 6,4))
  bfs <- matrix(NA, nrow=6, ncol = length(conditions))
  
  for(c in seq_along(conditions)){
    datCondition <- data[data$condition == conditions[c], ]
    for(i in 1:6){
      formula <- as.formula(paste(pull_scores[i], "~ composite_political_orientation_z"))
      freqres[c, i,] <- summary(
        lm(formula, datCondition))$coefficients["composite_political_orientation_z",]
      bfs[i, c] <- extractBF(lmBF(formula, data = datCondition))$bf
    }
  }
  
  res <- vector("list", length(conditions))
  
  for(c in seq_along(conditions)){
    res[[c]] <- data.frame(Mean_Score = MEANS[,c],
                    SD_Score = SDS[,c],
                    beta = freqres[c, ,1],
                    p_value = freqres[c, ,4],
                    bf = bfs[,c])
    rownames(res[[c]]) <- pull_scores
  }
  
  names(res) <- conditions
  
  return(res)
}

```

## Study 1a (Prolific)

```{r}
plot_pullscores(nhb1a, "Study 1a (Prolific)")
res <- analyze_pullscores1(nhb1a)
kable(res, digits = 3, row.names = TRUE, caption = "Study 1a (Prolific)")
```

## Study 1b (MTurk)

```{r}
plot_pullscores(nhb1a, "Study 1b (MTurk)")
res <- analyze_pullscores1(nhb1b)
kable(res, digits = 3, row.names = TRUE, caption = "Study 1b (MTurk)")
```
## Study 2 

```{r}
plot_pullscores(nhb2[nhb2$condition == "volitional",], "Study 2: Volitional Condition")
plot_pullscores(nhb2[nhb2$condition == "attitude",], "Study 2: Attitude Condition")
plot_pullscores(nhb2[nhb2$condition == "random",], "Study 2: Random Condition")

res <- analyze_pullscores2(nhb2)
conditions <- unique(nhb2$condition)
kable(res[[1]], digits = 3, row.names = TRUE, caption = paste("Study 2:", conditions[1]))
kable(res[[2]], digits = 3, row.names = TRUE, caption = paste("Study 2:", conditions[2]))
kable(res[[3]], digits = 3, row.names = TRUE, caption = paste("Study 2:", conditions[3]))

```
